chapter1:wake:0.speaker: narrator
chapter1:wake:0.sourceText: It was March fifth, in the year twenty-one ten.

chapter1:wake:1.speaker: narrator
chapter1:wake:1.sourceText: It was almost eleven at night on a remote island somewhere in the Atlantic Ocean. The island stretched roughly fifty-six kilometers across, about thirty-five miles from one side to the other, but most of it remained undeveloped wilderness. Near its center sat a research settlement of laboratories, homes, workshops, medical facilities, and other buildings supporting the nearly five hundred people who lived there.

chapter1:wake:2.speaker: narrator
chapter1:wake:2.sourceText: Deep inside one of those laboratories, Dr. Jack Bennett was hard at work. Technically.

chapter1:wake:3.speaker: narrator
chapter1:wake:3.sourceText: Jack sat slumped in his chair with his arms folded across his chest, his head tilted toward one shoulder, and several pages of diagnostic data glowing on the monitor in front of him. His eyes were closed.

chapter1:wake:4.speaker: narrator
chapter1:wake:4.sourceText: A warning tone chirped from Jack's console. He shifted but did not wake. A second tone followed, louder than the first, and the diagnostic display flashed amber.

chapter1:wake:6.speaker: narrator
chapter1:wake:6.sourceText: Jack jerked awake so quickly that his chair rolled backward and nearly struck another workstation.

chapter1:wake:8.speaker: narrator
chapter1:wake:8.sourceText: The warning repeated while Jack rubbed his eyes and leaned toward the monitor.

chapter1:trace:0.speaker: narrator
chapter1:trace:0.sourceText: Several windows were opening and closing on their own. Lines of commands streamed across one side of the display faster than he could read them. Jack grabbed the keyboard and opened the network monitor.

chapter1:trace:1.speaker: jack
chapter1:trace:1.sourceText: Come on. What are you doing?

chapter1:trace:2.speaker: narrator
chapter1:trace:2.sourceText: An unfamiliar connection appeared for half a second and vanished.

chapter1:trace:5.speaker: narrator
chapter1:trace:5.sourceText: He refreshed the display, but the connection was gone. Another warning tone sounded from the console and a red message filled the center of his screen.

chapter1:trace:8.speaker: narrator
chapter1:trace:8.sourceText: Jack entered a command and pulled up the laboratory access logs. Nothing looked unusual. He tried another search and got the same result.

chapter1:trace:10.speaker: narrator
chapter1:trace:10.sourceText: The system beeped, and a directory opened by itself. Jack stopped typing when he recognized the folder.

chapter1:lock:1.speaker: narrator
chapter1:lock:1.sourceText: He immediately locked the terminal. The screen went black for three seconds, then came back on and reopened the same directory.

chapter1:call:7.speaker: jack
chapter1:call:7.sourceText: I've got something weird on my computer. It tripped a security alarm.

chapter1:call:8.speaker: narrator
chapter1:call:8.sourceText: Sarah leaned closer to the intercom.

chapter1:call:11.speaker: jack
chapter1:call:11.sourceText: I think somebody's in the system.

chapter1:call:12.speaker: narrator
chapter1:call:12.sourceText: There was a brief pause before Sarah asked,

chapter1:call:14.speaker: narrator
chapter1:call:14.sourceText: Jack scanned the empty connection list.

chapter1:call:15.speaker: jack
chapter1:call:15.sourceText: No. That's why I'm calling the smarter scientist.

chapter1:call:16.speaker: narrator
chapter1:call:16.sourceText: Sarah laughed softly through the speaker.

chapter1:call:19.speaker: jack
chapter1:call:19.sourceText: Can you come take a look?

chapter1:call:22.speaker: narrator
chapter1:call:22.sourceText: Jack released the intercom and looked back at the monitor. The TOMBS directory was still open.

chapter1:call:24.speaker: narrator
chapter1:call:24.sourceText: The cursor moved without him touching anything.

chapter1:call:25.speaker: narrator
chapter1:call:25.sourceText: Jack froze as a file opened.

chapter1:arrive:0.speaker: narrator
chapter1:arrive:0.sourceText: He reached for the keyboard just as the laboratory door slid open behind him.

chapter1:arrive:1.speaker: narrator
chapter1:arrive:1.sourceText: Sarah Bennett walked straight in, tablet tucked beneath one arm, already crossing toward him. She glanced from Jack to the computer.

chapter1:arrive:2.speaker: sarah
chapter1:arrive:2.sourceText: Please tell me you didn't break something.

chapter1:arrive:5.speaker: narrator
chapter1:arrive:5.sourceText: Sarah closed the distance between them.

chapter1:arrive:6.speaker: sarah
chapter1:arrive:6.sourceText: You called me in here to admit that?

chapter1:arrive:12.speaker: jack
chapter1:arrive:12.sourceText: Whatever this is. I was reviewing yesterday's test results.

chapter1:arrive:21.speaker: narrator
chapter1:arrive:21.sourceText: She leaned over his shoulder and studied the screen.

chapter1:arrive:23.speaker: narrator
chapter1:arrive:23.sourceText: Jack straightened in his chair while Sarah placed her tablet beside the keyboard.

chapter1:arrive:24.speaker: jack
chapter1:arrive:24.sourceText: Right. Problem. I got an unauthorized access warning. I checked the network monitor and saw a connection I didn't recognize, but it disappeared before I could trace it.

chapter1:arrive:25.speaker: narrator
chapter1:arrive:25.sourceText: Sarah tapped the edge of the keyboard.

chapter1:arrive:27.speaker: narrator
chapter1:arrive:27.sourceText: Jack pointed to the open directory.

chapter1:arrive:32.speaker: narrator
chapter1:arrive:32.sourceText: Sarah looked at the terminal lock indicator.

chapter1:arrive:40.speaker: narrator
chapter1:arrive:40.sourceText: Sarah stared at him for a moment before looking back at the monitor. Jack pointed at the screen.

chapter1:logs:0.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:0.sourceText: Sarah started powering up the other console next to Jack.

chapter1:logs:2.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:2.sourceText: Jack kept one hand on the keyboard.

chapter1:logs:4.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:4.sourceText: Sarah nudged the arm of his chair, looking slightly annoyed, but sympathetic.

chapter1:logs:5.speaker: sarah
chapter1:logs:5.sourceText: Let me have your chair and get another chair.

chapter1:logs:6.speaker: jack
chapter1:logs:6.sourceText: Oh. Of course. Anything for you.

chapter1:logs:7.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:7.sourceText: Jack gave Sarah his chair, crossed to the next workstation, and dragged its chair back, wheels squeaking against the floor, before pulling himself up to his own screen.

chapter1:logs:10.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:10.sourceText: Jack watched his own log scroll.

chapter1:logs:12.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:12.sourceText: Sarah opened the connection history on her screen.

chapter1:logs:19.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:19.sourceText: Jack pulled up the TOMBS directory again, tracing back through what had changed.

chapter1:logs:21.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:21.sourceText: Sarah murmured after a few seconds, still scanning her own feed.

chapter1:logs:22.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:22.sourceText: Jack pointed at his own screen.

chapter1:logs:23.speaker: jack
chapter1:logs:23.sourceText: Mine too. Whoever it was covered both trails.

chapter1:logs:24.speaker: narrator
chapter1:logs:24.sourceText: Sarah narrowed her eyes at the display.

chapter1:baby:0.speaker: narrator
chapter1:baby:0.sourceText: Sarah shook her head, but Jack caught the beginning of a smile. He glanced at the time and then at her.

chapter1:baby:1.speaker: jack
chapter1:baby:1.sourceText: You know, you're supposed to be resting.

chapter1:baby:7.speaker: sarah
chapter1:baby:7.sourceText: No. You're the one I found asleep at a laboratory terminal.

chapter1:baby:10.speaker: narrator
chapter1:baby:10.sourceText: Sarah stopped typing long enough to look at him.

chapter1:baby:14.speaker: narrator
chapter1:baby:14.sourceText: Sarah gave him a look that answered the question for him.

chapter1:baby:15.speaker: narrator
chapter1:baby:15.sourceText: Jack surrendered with a small nod.

chapter1:baby:17.speaker: sarah
chapter1:baby:17.sourceText: Lately the baby seems to think eleven at night is morning.

chapter1:baby:18.speaker: narrator
chapter1:baby:18.sourceText: Sarah rested a hand briefly against her stomach, then returned to typing.

chapter1:baby:19.speaker: narrator
chapter1:baby:19.sourceText: Jack smiled at the movement beneath her hand.

chapter1:request:0.speaker: narrator
chapter1:request:0.sourceText: A new warning tone interrupted them. Both turned toward the main console as another message appeared.

chapter1:reject:0.speaker: narrator
chapter1:reject:0.sourceText: Jack reached across the console and rejected the request.

chapter1:credentials:0.speaker: narrator
chapter1:credentials:0.sourceText: He entered his administrator credentials, but a new message appeared before he could issue another command.

chapter1:credentials:2.speaker: narrator
chapter1:credentials:2.sourceText: Sarah looked from the message to him.
